title: Commercial Developer
description:
About the Job

Are you a commercially focused professional with strong expertise in bid management, commercial modelling, finance, and proposal development?

**OCS Services**
is looking for a
**Commercial Developer**
to join our
**Bids & Strategy team**
, based in
**Mumbai**
, with the flexibility to be transferred to
**Dubai if required**
.

This role will be responsible for developing commercial models for bids, coordinating with suppliers and internal stakeholders, supporting proposal development, identifying commercial deviations and risks, and ensuring effective control of costing and finance-related documentation.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of
**finance and accounting**
, excellent
**Microsoft Excel and Word skills**
, and the ability to develop structured commercial documentation to support bid and opportunity evaluation.

**Reporting to:**
Manager – Integrated Projects

**Department:**
Bids & Strategy

**Location:**
Mumbai / Dubai

About Us

OCS Services is a seasoned player in the oil & gas industry, delivering world-class services across offshore and onshore operations. As a joint venture between Planet Energy and BW Offshore, we specialize in Operations & Maintenance, Asset Integrity Management, and Integrated Crew Management.

With global operations spanning Singapore, India, UAE, Brazil, Côte d’Ivoire, and Nigeria, we are strategically positioned to support energy production safely, sustainably, and reliably. Our expertise, cutting-edge technology, and commitment to sustainability enable us to drive excellence in complex energy projects around the world.

At OCS, we're guided by four core values that define everything we do –
**Trust, Driven, Care and Innovation**
.

🌐 Learn more at: www.ocs.services

Join Us!

As we continue to strengthen our
**Bids & Strategy and Integrated Projects capabilities**
, we are seeking a commercially driven
**Commercial Developer**
to support our bid and proposal activities.

This is an opportunity to work closely with
**Finance & Accounts, Contracts, Legal, suppliers, and service providers**
, contributing directly to commercial modelling, risk assessment, bid evaluation, and proposal development.

What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

* Develop
  **commercial models**
  for each bid.
* Interact with
  **suppliers and service providers**
  to obtain quotations in line with bid requirements.
* Coordinate with
  **Finance & Accounts, Contracts, and Legal teams**
  to ensure all relevant clauses are effectively incorporated into the commercial model.
* Develop
  **terms and conditions**
  for proposal submissions and validate them against standard terms and conditions templates.
* Coordinate with Legal, Contracts, and Finance teams to develop
  **pre-bid query documents**
  .
* Identify and highlight
  **commercial deviations**
  requiring attention or approval.
* Develop
  **risk management documents**
  , highlighting key risks and recommending appropriate mitigation strategies for the BVH / Bid-in-Charge.
* Ensure effective
  **document control and revision control**
  of costing sheets and other Finance & Accounts-related documents.
* Develop
  **bid approval notes and opportunity evaluation sheets**
  .
* Support the preparation and organization of commercial documentation required for bid submissions and internal approvals.
* Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure commercial requirements are addressed effectively and within the bid process.

What We Are Looking For

Qualifications

* **MBA in Finance – Mandatory.**
* **Engineering background – Desirable.**

Technical & Functional Skills

* Strong understanding of
  **Finance and Accounting**
  .
* Strong proficiency in
  **Microsoft Office**
  , particularly
  **Microsoft Word and Excel**
  .
* Advanced knowledge of
  **Microsoft Excel is preferred**
  .
* Ability to create, format, and maintain professional
  **commercial documents and Excel spreadsheets**
  .
* Ability to use
  **Excel formulas and tools efficiently**
  .
* Good understanding of commercial modelling, costing documentation, and bid-related financial information.

What Will Help You Succeed

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in commercial documentation.
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders across
  **Finance, Contracts, Legal, suppliers, and service providers**
  .
* Structured approach to managing costing sheets, revisions, and bid documentation.
* Ability to analyse commercial information and clearly highlight risks and deviations.
* Strong ownership of assigned bid-related deliverables.

What You Can Expect

* Opportunity to contribute to
  **Oil & Gas bids and strategic opportunities**
  .
* Exposure to
  **commercial modelling, costing, risk management, and bid evaluation**
  .
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams including
  **Finance & Accounts, Contracts, Legal, suppliers, and service providers**
  .
* Exposure to commercial aspects of
  **integrated projects and business opportunities**
  .
* Opportunity to contribute directly to proposal development and internal bid decision-making.
* Potential opportunity to work in
  **Mumbai and Dubai**
  , depending on business requirements.

Why Join OCS?

At OCS Services, you will be part of a global Oil & Gas organization working across multiple geographies and supporting complex energy projects.

If you have a strong understanding of
**finance, commercial modelling, Excel, and bid-related processes**
, and are looking for an opportunity to contribute to strategic bids and business opportunities,
**we encourage you to apply today!**

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
EIT is a centralized group within Global Risk Management responsible for independent testing of operational processes within the eight lines of business and enterprise control functions at Bank of America to ensure the company is in compliance with domestic and international laws, rules and regulations, and that risk and controls procedures are operating effectively.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The Sampling & Test Development associate is responsible for designing and supporting high-quality manual and automated testing solutions through effective sampling, data validation, and governance practices. This role collaborates with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data partners, and Test Execution teams to ensure accurate data sourcing, sound sampling methodologies, and test structures that support automation.
  
  
The associate independently acquires and validates data from internal and external sources, documents testing procedures and sampling requirements, and resolves issues related to data procurement, sample design, and test development. The role is accountable for maintaining data integrity, implementing changes to sampling requirements, and ensuring accurate tracking of testing activities within the System of Record (SOR).
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Partner with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data providers, and Test Execution teams to develop and enhance manual and automated testing approaches.
* Gather, validate, and document data requirements, ensuring accurate sample populations and alignment with test objectives.
* Incorporate appropriate sampling methodologies and governance requirements into test plans and execution strategies.
* Evaluate and coordinate pilot testing activities, providing recommendations to improve test effectiveness and quality.
* Design, maintain, and update sampling procedures, test scripts, and support documentation.
* Drive test structures and methodologies that enable automation and scalable testing solutions.
* Participate across the testing lifecycle, including intake, planning, execution, reporting, and issue remediation, providing subject matter expertise and guidance.
* Analyze, manipulate, and summarize large data sets to support testing activities and deliver high-quality results.
* Identify and resolve data sourcing, sampling, and test design issues while maintaining data integrity and compliance standards.
* Maintain accurate test status, milestones, and deliverables within the System of Record (SOR).
* Lead initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Escalate and drive resolution of areas requiring process refinement, policy updates, or procedural enhancements.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support effective test execution and risk management objectives.

**Requirements:**
**Education details:**
Graduates or Post-Graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics. Tech/B.E./B.Sc.(Statistics)/B.C.A./M.C.A/M.Sc.(Statistics)
  
  
**Experience Range:**
6-8 yrs
  
  
**Certifications (if Any):**

* CRCM, CAMS, FRM, CRISC, CISA
* SQL, SAS, Python
* PCEP / PCAP Python Certification
* Microsoft Power BI Certification
* Alteryx Designer Certification
* PMP, Agile, or Scrum Certifications
* DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server
* Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word
* JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint
* Enterprise Data Warehouse

**Foundational skills\***

* Extensive experience in Audit, Testing, Quality Assurance, Risk, and Compliance functions, with Compliance or Risk-related certifications considered an advantage.
* Strong expertise in sampling methodologies, test design, test execution, and quality assurance frameworks, with the ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive testing requirements.
* Advanced technical proficiency in SQL, SAS, Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Cognos, MicroStrategy, Power BI, and other business intelligence and analytics platforms.
* Hands-on experience sourcing, validating, and analyzing data from diverse environments including DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop, Hive, and enterprise data warehouses.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing, data mining, data acquisition, and automation concepts, with a proven ability to identify and implement efficiency improvements through automation.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, including data analytics, Pivot Tables, Power Query, Lookups, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
* Demonstrated project management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities, meet service level agreements (SLAs), and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional analytical, critical-thinking, research, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently solve complex business and technical challenges.
* Strong business acumen and extensive functional knowledge, coupled with the ability to assess risk, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive operational excellence.
* Excellent verbal, written, and business communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and effectively engage with senior leadership.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships, collaborate across multiple lines of business, and influence stakeholders to achieve strategic objectives.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and highly organized professional capable of working independently with minimal supervision while maintaining a strong team-oriented mindset.
* Strong attention to detail, issue management, time management, quality focus, and commitment to continuous improvement.
* Demonstrates courage, accountability, and sound judgment while navigating complex business, regulatory, and operational environments.

**Work Timings:**
12:30 to 21:30
  
  
**Job Location:**
GIFT City / Mumbai

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

That is why Third Bridge is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Spydra - SAP IS-U ABAP Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP IS-U ABAP Technical Consultant with 7+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development and strong expertise in SAP Industry-Specific Solution for Utilities (IS-U). The candidate should have hands-on experience in developing, enhancing, integrating, and supporting SAP IS-U solutions, with a strong understanding of utilities business processes such as Device Management, Meter Reading, Billing, Invoicing, and FI-CA.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have experience in technical design, development, performance optimization, production support, and collaboration with functional and business teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and implement custom solutions using SAP ABAP in the SAP IS-U environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows.
* Work extensively with ABAP Objects, Reports, ALV, BAPIs, BAdIs, User Exits, Enhancement Framework, and Function Modules.
* Develop and enhance SAP IS-U functionalities related to Device Management, Meter Reading, Billing, Invoicing, and FI-CA.
* Work on SAP IS-U-specific objects, function modules, business processes, and standard enhancement points.
* Develop and support interfaces between SAP IS-U and external systems using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, Web Services, and file-based integrations.
* Analyze functional specifications and prepare technical specifications and development estimates.
* Perform debugging, root-cause analysis, code optimization, and performance tuning.
* Support incident resolution, defect fixing, and change requests in production and non-production environments.
* Work on data migration, data conversion, and mass processing programs related to SAP IS-U.
* Collaborate with SAP IS-U functional consultants, integration teams, and business stakeholders.
* Conduct unit testing, support integration testing and UAT, and ensure adherence to SAP development standards.
* Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, transport management, and release activities.
* Provide technical guidance to junior developers and support knowledge transfer.

**Required Technical Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development, preferably with substantial hands-on experience in SAP IS-U.
* Strong knowledge of ABAP programming, including:
* Reports, ALV Reports, and Classical/Interactive Reports
* ABAP Objects and Object-Oriented Programming
* BAPIs, BAdIs, User Exits, and Enhancement Framework
* Function Modules, RFCs, and IDocs
* Smart Forms, SAPscript, and Adobe Forms
* Data Dictionary (DDIC), internal tables, and Open SQL
* Debugging, performance tuning, and runtime analysis
* Good understanding of SAP IS-U business processes, including:
* Device Management and Meter Reading
* Billing and Invoicing
* Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA)
* Business Master Data, such as Business Partner, Contract Account, and Contract
* Experience developing and supporting interfaces with third-party systems.
* Ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions.
* Experience in technical documentation, testing, and production support.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Utilities or SAP IS-U on SAP S/4HANA.
* Knowledge of CDS Views, AMDP, OData, and modern ABAP development.
* Exposure to SAP Fiori, SAP Gateway, and integration technologies.
* Experience with SAP Workflow and background job processing.
* Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, ServiceNow, or similar ticketing tools.
* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or other structured delivery methodologies.

title: AI Java Lead Engineer _ Vice President _Software Engineering
description:
We're seeking someone to join our Institutional Securities Technology (Prime Brokerage AND Institutional Equity) team as a Java Backend Engineer to build scalable, high-performance enterprise applications on a team that's adopting agentic AI workflows (built on frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK). This is fundamentally a backend engineering role — the bar is deep Java/Spring Boot craftsmanship and strong problem-solving. AI/agentic experience is crucial; we need someone who is aware & can quickly pick up orchestrator/subagent patterns & eval workflows.
  
  
In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Lead Software Engineer position at Vice President Level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintains software solutions that support business needs.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

description:

**Role**

**Reports To**
TBC
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
Position Purpose
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Own backend architecture decisions, API design, data access patterns, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React
**.**
Bring the depth of an experienced backend engineer with the breadth to contribute across the full stack. Leverage AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of day-to-day engineering practice.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular).
* Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance.
* Design and Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions.
* Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration.
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery.
* Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization.
* Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube.
* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust, compliant technical solutions.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration
* Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards
* Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery
* Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.
* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**
**Skill Group**
**Details**
**Core Java & JDK 21+**

* Modern language features – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
* Concurrency & Parallelism – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
* JVM & GC tuning – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.
* Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
* Build & Unit‑test foundation – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

* Spring Boot 3.x – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
* Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
* Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).
* Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
* Spring Security– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

* SQL & query optimisation – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).
* Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
* ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
* NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
* Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

* Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
* Domain‑Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
* API‑first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
* Event‑driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.
* Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.
* Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy
  
  

* Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
* Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

* Containerisation & K8s – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
* CI/CD pipeline – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
* Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.
* Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
* Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Test‑pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
* Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
* Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**
Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.
  
  
**AI Tools**
Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas
  
  
Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.
  
  
Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
* Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
* Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
* Ensures that security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in.
* Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
* Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‑native solutions.
* Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

**Education Level:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

Our best-in-class offering includes accounting and investors services, portfolio analytics, middle-office functions, regulatory and financial reporting, and tax services. Delivering these services to our clients and their investors is a diverse team of 1,400 highly skilled employees across the globe based in New York, London, Glasgow, Dublin, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hong Kong. Joining MSFS, you will discover a dynamic environment where every day offers new opportunities for personal growth and innovation. Here at MSFS your career isn’t just a job, it’s an incredible journey fueled by collaboration, challenge, and the chance to make a meaningful impact to our business, our clients, their investors and the wider Morgan Stanley franchise.
  
  
The Product Development team is the engine at the heart of our MSFS technology ecosystem, ensuring our platforms perform seamlessly for clients and colleagues every day while leading transformative changes across our business. Through the team’s deep partnership with our Technology department, they are reimagining how we work and how clients and their investors engage with MSFS. This team enables breakthrough innovation and an elevated user experience. Product Development is also at the forefront of adopting advanced technologies, including robotics and artificial intelligence, to deliver greater scale, efficiency, and operational excellence for MSFS and its stakeholders.
  
  
The current opening is for the Client Computing Solutions (CCS) Team which is part of Product Development function. The CCS Team develops tools to resolve complex business problems that are overwhelming and error-prone if handled manually by front-line colleagues. Complexity is often found in areas such as investor services, investor allocation, regulatory reporting, capital activities and trade transaction management. The Team is comprised of colleagues who have had solid technical education and have studied finance and accounting as the chosen field to apply the skills. The CCS Team tends to focus on very complex, specific and urgent circumstances, and the solutions tend to be highly customized for the clients concerned, and rapid turnaround is usually a requirement.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You’ll Do In The Role**

* Liaise with executive management & business users across locations to understand/ document business requirements, detail the use cases & propose solution options
* Design & develop a solution which is flexible to incorporate changes and scalable
* End-to-end ownership of the tools built for client processes
* Envisioning scenarios and take steps to incorporate them in the solution
* Own deliverables across the automation journey to ensure the use cases and scenarios are properly documented & analysed
* Create & manage project plans, call out risks & issues proactively, report progress against the plan & track associated project benefits
* Create training plans & provide trainings to team-members & users as need arises
* Ability to wear multiple hats including but not limited to Business Analyst, Developer (20-30% Coding might be required), Project Manager, Tester & Business User

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* B.Tech./ B.E. or an equivalent engineering degree along with either MBA or equivalent degree in Finance/ Accounting or CFA or equivalent certification with 5+ years of relevant work experience
* Demonstrated programming skills in any one language, experience with Python, VBA is a plus
* Demonstrated interest and skills in technology and process management
* Ability to work with Microsoft office: Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access
* Knowledge of databases, database concepts with ability to handle large data-set will be a plus
* Strong project management skills with ability to take ownership & lead projects independently with minimum supervision
* Working knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, Rally or any other in-house developed tools
* Strong communication skills & ability to interface with executive management, business users and technology development teams in multiple locations
* Should be detailed oriented and must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Experience of working with multiple stakeholders for prioritisation and tracking of requirements
* Inclination to manage/supervise people and work as part of focused globally distributed teams, in a complex matrix environment
* Ability to handle pressure, effectively prioritize and handle multiple tasks with high level of accuracy
* Proactive, positive, self-motivated & a good team player

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.
* AWS, Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications.

What are our core values
  
  
Integrity
  
  
Determined
  
  
Innovative
  
  
Collaborative

We have a very diverse and inclusive culture.We invest in developing our people. Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.
* Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions.
* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.
* Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects.
* Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects.
* Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance.
* Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks.
* Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

**Process Overview:**
Equity group span across various offering like prime brokerage, Equities trading. This includes physical and synthetic financing solutions for clients who desire to gain market exposure and financing to securities in the Equity, Fixed Income and FX marketplaces. BAML’s offering spans multiple areas within GBAM, each of which provide specific offerings to our clients. we implement innovative software solutions to provide our clients with a seamless trading experience. Solutions includes low touch trading, FIX connectivity, low latency market connectivity, smart order routing, algorithmic trading, and internal crossing.
  
  
**Job Description**
The individual will be a senior member of the
**Equity Swaps Technology Development team**
and will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing and delivering business-critical applications supporting the Equity Swaps business. He/She will be expected to have
**strong hands-on Python development experience**
, sound software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to work on complex enterprise applications and technology platforms.
  
  
The individual should be well versed with
**Global Markets concepts, preferably Equities/Equity Derivatives**
, and should be a self-starter with the ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  
  
The individual should be self-motivated, creative and proactive, with the ability to operate successfully in a fast-paced environment comprising multiple applications, platforms and technologies. The individual will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, production support teams and other global technology partners throughout the SDLC. The role will involve
**solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, performance optimization, deployment and production stability**
.
  
  
The role requires the candidate to be passionate and hands-on with technology, with strong analytical, programming, debugging and problem-solving skills. The individual will actively participate in
**system design and architecture discussions**
in addition to implementation, testing and deployment. The ideal candidate will be a fast learner with strong programming acumen, the ability to develop a good understanding of the Equity Swaps domain, and sufficient experience to deliver complex projects with
**minimal supervision and end-to-end ownership**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Interact with Business Partners, Product Owners and Technology teams to understand requirements and develop appropriate technical solutions.
* Understand business and technology priorities and collaborate with global teams on technical solutions and future development initiatives.
* Participate actively and provide recommendations in global technical design and architecture discussions.
* Design, develop, enhance and maintain high-quality Python applications and services supporting the Equity Swaps business.
* Develop clean, reusable, maintainable and well-tested code in accordance with established software engineering standards.
* Contribute to development and enhancement of applications leveraging the Quartz framework.
* Design and integrate application components using APIs, messaging, databases and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Perform hands-on troubleshooting, debugging, root-cause analysis and resolution of complex application issues.
* Develop appropriate unit and integration tests and ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve application performance, scalability, resiliency, maintainability and observability.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards, engineering best practices and application controls.
* Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps and automated software delivery practices.
* Be capable of independently driving development initiatives and delivering projects with end-to-end ownership and accountability.
* Ensure high-quality standards across all technical deliverables.
* Participate and contribute to Agile ceremonies, project compliance reviews and audit activities.
* Learn and adopt new technologies as future development may involve diverse platforms, software, frameworks and tools.
* Effectively communicate technical concepts and solutions through both written and verbal discussions.
* Adhere to the team’s governing principles, development standards and policies.
* Participate in mandatory training and cross-functional initiatives across the team.
* Demonstrate enthusiasm and willingness to build strong Equity Swaps and Global Markets domain knowledge.

**Requirements:**
**Education:**
B.E./B.Tech/M.S./M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  
  
**Certifications (if any):**
Relevant Python, Cloud or software engineering certifications are not mandatory but will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Experience Range:**
**6- 9 years**
**Foundational Skills:**

* Strong hands-on Python development experience with excellent programming and software engineering fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms and design patterns.
* Experience designing, developing and supporting complex enterprise-scale applications.
* Strong knowledge of application architecture and ability to translate functional requirements into effective technical designs.
* Experience with Quartz framework would be a strong advantage.
* Confident working in Linux environments, including shell scripting.
* Strong experience with SQL, relational databases and data management concepts.
* Experience developing and integrating applications using APIs and service-based interfaces.
* Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing and automated testing practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience with source control, build processes and CI/CD practices.
* Understanding of application performance, resiliency, scalability and production stability considerations.
* Demonstrable experience developing or supporting applications in complex technology environments.
* Business knowledge or exposure to Equities, Equity Derivatives, Equity Swaps or Global Markets is preferred.
* Knowledge of FIX protocol and financial markets integration would be advantageous.
* Ability to participate effectively in technical design and architecture discussions.
* Ability to face off to senior management, business stakeholders and technology partners globally.
* Ability and expertise working in an Agile development methodology.
* Ability to take ownership of complex development deliverables and work with minimal supervision.
* Must be a self-starter with excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.

**Desired Skills:**

* Possess strong analytical, programming, problem-solving and creative thinking skills.Hands-on experience developing solutions using the Quartz framework.
* Work experience in Global Markets / Equities / Equity Swaps / Prime Brokerage technology.
* Understanding of Equity Swaps products and trade lifecycle would be an advantage.
* Experience developing high-volume, scalable or performance-sensitive applications.
* Exposure to distributed application architecture, APIs and messaging technologies.
* Experience implementing and improving application resiliency and production stability.
* Experience with application performance monitoring, profiling and optimization.
* Exposure to observability and monitoring technologies, such as Prometheus, Splunk, Dynatrace and OpenTelemetry (OTEL).
* Exposure to architecture and design practices across Python, Java and/or Scala technology stacks.
* Hands-on experience with Cloud and Containerization technologies, including Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Hands-on experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools, such as Ansible and Jenkins.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks and engineering practices that improve software quality and delivery efficiency.

Possess strong
**analytical, programming, problem-solving and creative thinking skills**
.

Mumbai/Chennai
