title: Applications Technical Specialist II
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**
***As an Applications Technical Specialist II with Worley***
, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
**Project and User Support**

* Provide P6 (Cloud and On-Premise) system technical support to projects and users.
* Proactively seek out ways to help projects and users maximize efficiency using P6.
* Shadow New Project Teams and ensure project is being correctly and P6 is used effectively.
* Review project system health checks, lessons learned and provide feedback to the P6 Team on user experience and process enhancements required.
* Restore P6 dump in Oracle/SQL database.
* Knowledge of web services and its usage for interface or report.
* Support maintenance of P6 by gathering requirements, writing specifications, and managing development, User Acceptance Testing and Implementation of the changes.
* Setup a new on-premises instance of P6 using Oracle/SQL database.

**Project Implementation**

* Assist projects where required with the set up and configuration of projects in P6.
* Assist in interface development with web services.

**Training**

* Develop and maintain training documentation.
* Develop and maintain User Guides and Best Practices Guides.
* Develop additional documentation as required.

**P6 Knowledge and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain in-depth knowledge of P6 in all modules ( Risk Analysis (PRA), Team Members and P6 Analysis) and associated work processes.
* Maintain and support system integrations with external systems.
* Maintain a high level of understanding of functional work processes and procedures, overall EPC business, and project execution.
* Investigate ways to improve productivity, efficiency, or information availability and visibility for projects using P6.
* Evaluate new system functionality and determine if fit for purpose.
* Communicate regularly with location P6 support teams regarding changes in P6 that may impact projects and users, and to understand the status of P6 project implementation and usage effectiveness.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* 5+ years’ experience with P6 usage, support, administration, Technical and configuration.
* Familiar with Service Now or other ticketing systems.
* Performed Migration of Oracle/SQL database and know usage of web services.
* Strong overall understanding of project requirements, deliverables and workflows.
* Understanding of training and development concepts.
* Ability to implement, test and troubleshoot systems.
* Ability to effectively deliver presentations to both internal and external stakeholders.

**Other Requirements**

* Experience of working in cross cultural environment is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle and SQL database.
* Able to think analytically in a problem-solving environment.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and work under pressure to meet deadlines.

**People Skills**

* Able to actively initiate inter-discipline / department dialogue.
* Strong written and oral presentation skills.
* Able to transfer and capture location knowledge and mentor/coach others within the Location to engage in knowledge sharing and system activities.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. * Meet cloud security standards and reduce operational and security risk.

  **.**

  or strong familiarity with any pub/sub or RPC-over-WebSocket protocol; WAMP can be learned on the job.

* Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering with 6+ years of experience in relevant areas.
* Masters Degree in Computer Science a plus.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

title: Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS
description:
**Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Role: Full time, Founding Team**

**Joining: November**

Looking for an engineer who is also an Entrepreneur, Builder and Mr. Figureoutable at heart to join our founding team.

**About Us:**

We are a D2C brand led by IITR alum. We are pre-launch and have raised pre-seed funding backed by founders of Souled Store, TIGC, partners from Investment banking, and strong startup operators.

We aim to become a 5000 Crore brand by 2030 and tech would be at the core of how we achieve this goal.

**But why hire in tech for a D2C brand?**

We're building what we hope will be
**one of India's first truly AI-native, tech-first D2C brands.**

* Not a D2C company that occasionally uses ChatGPT.
* A company where AI and technology are at the core of how we operate, make decisions, serve customers, and scale

Thus we are looking for a
**Founding Engineer cum AI builder**

to make this happen.

**Who are we looking for?**

* A strong full-stack engineer, AI enthusiast, problem solver, and someone with serious entrepreneurial energy.
* Has a high bias for action. You'd rather ship something in 3 days than discuss it for 3 weeks.
* Someone who can independently take products from idea to deployment.
* Can build for web and mobile (or is confident in figuring out what they don't know).
* Is genuinely excited about, stays highly updated and has built products using AI, LLMs, agents, and automation.
* Thinks like a founder, not just an engineer.
* Loves ownership, ambiguity, and figuring things out.
* Bachelors from tier-1 colleges - IIT/BITS/IIIT
* Bonus: Experience building AI agents, agentic AI systems which are being used on production and at scale would be a big plus
* Bonus: ex-founders, ex-founding engineer at funded startups

**What will you actually do?**

Pretty much everything tech.

* Build our website, mobile app, and customer-facing experiences.
* Build AI agents and automate workflows across marketing, operations, customer experience, and more.
* Experiment with new AI tools, ship quickly, break things, fix things.
* Own the entire tech stack, from writing code to deploying products.
* Eventually help build the tech team as we scale.

**Why this should be exciting?**

* Because you will one of the first few engineers in India who will build a real-life case study on building brands in the age of AI.
* You'll get to experiment with technology across the entire business, not just a product; and you get to see the impact your work is bringing.
* If you have that entrepreneurial itch, this could be one of the most interesting ways to scratch it.
* It's the perfect opportunity if you are looking for a role that could be a stepping stone before building your own startup

**Important Disclaimer**

* **This might come with a pay cut.**

  If maximizing your salary over the next 12 months is your top priority, this probably isn't the right opportunity.
* We're looking for someone optimizing for
  **ownership, learning, building incredible things, and long-term upside.**
* There will be meaningful ESOPs, real decision-making power, and a chance to build something that becomes a case study talked about globally.

**﻿
Interested?**

* **Email below details at**
  palakjajoo10@gmail.com
* **Your gitbhub**
* **Latest resume (not fully updated also works)**
* **Link to something you've built that you're ridiculously proud of at**
  palakjajoo10@gmail.com
  ,
* Short writeup on why do you want to join an extremely early stage startup?

title: Software Engineer
description:
[Note: This is a job that requires onsite in Thane. If you are not able to, please do not apply.]

We are looking for someone to join our company and push the frontiers of enterprise AI further.

This is not going to be just another software engineering job. We will need you to be flexible with your job scope, which includes nurturing younger software developers, strategising together with the management on the product and go-to-market, maintaining the coding standards, and then some.

As we are pushing the frontiers, the direction and execution clarity are often vague, iterative, and less structured. If you thrive in a place where autonomy given is high, and are able to translate broad visions to concrete steps, this is for you.

**About Pints AI**

Pints AI is a multi-award-winning AI company based in Singapore, known for deploying on-premise, privacy-preserving AI systems in some of Asia’s most regulated industries - including banks, insurers, and government entities.

* Won AI in Finance Global Challenge (2023) at SFF in Singapore
* Built the 1.5 Pints open-source model - a compact LLM outperforming Apple’s OpenELM and Microsoft’s Phi-1.5
* Developed Autothought, our AI reporting engine, now used to replace business analysts in regulated verticals

* Writing clean, high-quality, high-performance, maintainable code

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field)

* Experience with Agile or Scrum software development methodologies
* Ability to multi-task, organize, and prioritize work
* Solid TypeScript/JS and Python experience
* React, Node/Express, REST APIs
* Git, Docker, Linux familiarity
* Understanding of embeddings, vector stores, LangChain/LlamaIndex
* Self-starter mindset - comfortable moving in ambiguity
* Exposure to RAG or LLM-driven tools is a bonus

**What You’ll Do**

1. Prototype Real-World AI Use Cases

* Apply Autothought to solve problems in claims, compliance, risk, onboarding, and more

2. Full-Stack Software Engineering

* Own the development of AI-powered internal tools (React + Express)

* Level up fast through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on deployments

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office**
**Senior Software Engineer - Backend**
Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
Join an Agile team of professionals that are instrumental in building the next generation of travel applications. We constantly explore new technologies and engineer better solutions for ever demanding business needs.
  
  
Our team of engineers, at all levels, work with the business leaders in defining the product roadmap and come up with innovative solutions to grow the future of travel. We design and develop our back end systems and REST APIs that serve hundreds of millions of searches a day, collecting and parsing data across thousands of partners to get the best deals for our customers
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Drive mission critical projects with direct impact on the evolution of Priceline's business.
* Innovate with a cross-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates and delivers on new product objectives.
* Showcase fluency and development skills of Java
* Lead, mentor, and guide the team in best practices.
* Apply your programming skills towards building low latency and high throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing.
* Implement SQL composition skills that collects and queries data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications.
* The ability to quickly apply your experience to understand our codebase, systems and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications.
* Influencer and communicator on team development efforts. Influence what the best solutions are and communicate your findings to key business stakeholders.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering and development.
* Exceptional coding experience with Java.
* An interest in being a mentor and influencing best practices with less experienced developers.
* Strong grasp of SQL compositions skills for composing queries and analysis.
* Confident with the utilization of Spring Frameworks, Web Services and APIs.
* Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP.
* Experience in Microservices, Kubernetes (GKE preferable), and Dockers.
* Proven ability in Design and Architecture of complex, highly scalable and performance driven applications.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

SKILL SET

JOB REQUIRMENTS

support investment management operations, portfolio management processes, and

enterprise business workflows.

design, and best practices.

third-party technology vendors.

Develop operational and management reports to support business decision-making and

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. title: FutureFocus India - Technology 2026
description:
Ready to kickstart your career in one of the world's leading tech-driven trading firms?
  
  
Join
**FutureFocus in Mumbai**
, an all-expenses-paid five-day program designed to ignite your potential as a future trader, researcher or software engineer at Optiver.
  
  
Dive into the fundamentals of trading, gain unique insights into Optiver’s cutting-edge trading systems and build the key skills that our traders, researchers and engineers use every day.
  
  
Plus, if you've excelled in the program, you could receive an offer for our 2028 Summer Internship Program.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
We are hiring Senior / Lead Engineers to design, build, and scale robust, production-grade data and platform systems for a product portfolio within Blenheim. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own complex problem areas end-to-end, influence system architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable solutions in a fast-growing, product-led environment.
  
  
If you enjoy working with ambiguity, building platforms from the ground up, and shipping real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.

**About Us**
Founded in 1995, Zema Global Data Corporation empowers organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and make faster, more confident decisions that drive measurable results. At Zema Global, we Think Big, Make It Happen, and Win as One. We thrive on collaboration, creativity, and respect, united by a shared drive to innovate and deliver meaningful impact for our customers and communities. If you’re inspired by solving complex challenges and contributing to a culture that values purpose and performance, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are hiring an AI Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience to build and run AI agents across our data and analytics platform. These agents will take on a growing range of work for customers and internal teams, using LLMs, tools and retrieval in production. You will build agents end to end and help operate them once they are live, monitoring their behavior, cost and quality (often called Agent Ops). You will work closely with senior engineers, data engineers and product managers, and ship to real customers.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Build agents**

* Asa the AI Software Engineer, you will design and build LLM agents that plan multi-step tasks and call tools, such as querying internal data APIs, running analytics or generating reports.
* Rapidly prototype new agent ideas, put them in front of users early and iterate quickly based on feedback.
* Define clear tool interfaces (names, schemas, descriptions) and connect agents to internal services, including through protocols like MCP.
* Build retrieval (RAG) so agents ground answers in governed company data: chunking, embeddings, vector search and citations.
* Write and iterate on system prompts, tool descriptions and guardrails.
* Contribute to multi-agent and human-in-the-loop workflows where a task needs review or approval.
* Run and monitor agents (AgentOps).
* Instrument agents with tracing so every step, tool call and output can be inspected and replayed.
* Track quality, latency, token cost, tool error rates and task success in dashboards and alerts.
* Build and maintain evaluation sets; run evals before each release to catch regressions.
* Investigate failures such as wrong tool calls, loops, hallucinations and timeouts, and ship fixes.
* Keep agent actions traceable and auditable, in line with customers' governance and compliance needs.

**Engineering**

* Write production Python services and APIs, and deploy them on cloud infrastructure with CI/CD.
* Work with product and domain experts to turn customer problems into agent use cases.
* Write clear documentation and join code reviews.

**Essential**
**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years of professional experience in AI/ML or software engineering (internships and strong projects count).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong Python skills, including async code, typed data models (e.g. Pydantic) and REST APIs.
* Hands-on experience building at least one LLM agent or tool-using application, at work or in a project you can show us.
* Ability to prototype rapidly and iterate on ideas quickly: turning a rough idea into a working demo in days, then improving it.
* Experience with LLM APIs (for example Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure OpenAI), function/tool calling and structured outputs.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph or a similar agent framework (such as CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain or an agent SDK).
* Understanding of how to evaluate LLM output: test sets, metrics and LLM-as-judge.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Git.
* Clear communication and a willingness to learn a new domain.

Desirable
  
  

* Cloud agent platforms: AWS (Amazon Bedrock Agents or Bedrock AgentCore) or Azure (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Semantic Kernel or Microsoft Agent Framework).
* Experience with agent observability or LLMOps tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases or OpenTelemetry.
* Building MCP servers or other tool integrations for agents.
* Multi-agent systems, planning, memory or human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Knowledge of agent security risks, such as prompt injection and over-broad tool permissions.
* Deploying agents on AWS or Azure with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Interest in or exposure to energy, commodities, trading or financial markets.
* Time-series data and forecasting.
* Vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and embedding models.

You will work closely with traders, quantitative researchers and engineers in Mumbai and across IMC's global offices taking ownership of end-to-end high-impact product development - from requirements gathering through to production deployment and monitoring. * Ability to work independently and take full ownership of the solutions you build and deliver.
* Natural problem-solver and team player; curious, adaptable and proactive in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English.
* Interest in financial markets / trading. Prior experience in trading or related industries is a plus but NOT required.

**Tech stack**

We constantly evolve our technology stack and look for tools that best suit the problems at hand. If a new technology holds promise, we actively explore, adopt, and develop it.
  
  
**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

The role centers on creating next‑generation AML capabilities and will be instrumental in protecting the BNPP Group from fraud, money‑laundering, and other financial crimes by using advanced technologies and innovative solutions.
  
  
As an AI-ML Engineer, you will design, train and deploy machine learning models that detect money laundering and financial crime. This position is vital for shaping the core detection capability of the platform. This also involves execution of various AML initiatives, thereby strengthening the organization’s overall risk management.
  
  
While direct AML experience is not mandatory, a strong foundation in machine learning, sound engineering practices, and a willingness to learn the financial-crime domain are essential. Familiarity with regulated environments, model governance, or fraud and anomaly detection is an advantage, but we are primarily looking for engineers who can build robust, well-calibrated, production-grade models and reason carefully about their real-world impact. The role will operate within a globally distributed environment.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Development & Evaluation – Design, train, and assess ML models (NNs, GNNs, gradient‑boosted ensembles, unsupervised anomaly detectors) for money‑laundering detection across transaction, client, and network levels.
* Feature Engineering Pipeline – Build and optimise Spark/Delta Lake pipelines, ensuring feature consistency between training and production.
* Lifecycle Management – Track experiments, version models, and run champion‑challenger workflows with MLflow.
* Low‑Latency Deployment – Deploy and maintain inference services (e.g., BentoML) on the on‑prem Kubernetes platform.
* Calibration & Scoring – Calibrate models and map scores to probabilities to deliver reliable, decision‑ready risk scores.
* Explainability & Governance – Provide model explainability for audits, document design/assumptions/validation, and guarantee full reproducibility and auditability for regulatory compliance.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Partner with data engineers, graph/LLM specialists, and compliance analysts to translate detection requirements into production‑ready models.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Python engineering & secure code – Expert in object‑oriented, modular, and reusable Python code; packaging, logging, metrics, and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); security primitives (OAuth2/JWT) and data‑privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA).
* ML modeling & calibration – Hands‑on with PyTorch (custom architectures, focal loss, training loops, GPU optimization), XGBoost/LightGBM, scikit‑learn/Keras/TensorFlow; deep knowledge of model calibration (Platt scaling, score‑to‑probability, MC‑Dropout), evaluation (PR/AUC‑ROC, F‑beta, lift charts) and handling class imbalance along with the underlying statistical concepts (calibration theory, hypothesis testing).
* Large‑scale data processing – Proficient in Pandas, Dask, Polars (or equivalent) for transactional‑scale datasets; feature engineering, distributed pipelines, and performance‑aware data handling.
* MLOps & lifecycle management – MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, stage promotion), BentoML (runners, adaptive batching, CPU/GPU pools), GitOps/Argo CD for A/B‑testing and champion‑challenger workflows; CI/CD pipelines with Git/Bitbucket.
* Python microservices & containerization – Designing and deploying APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Django; async I/O, Celery task queues, Docker packaging, and Kubernetes orchestration for scalable inference services.
* Data storage & query optimization – Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph stores (Cassandra, MongoDB, Neo4j, JanusGraph); schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ); cross‑team and multi‑geography collaboration, rapid technology adoption, mentorship, and end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.
* Strong collaboration and learning mindset, with the ability to work across teams and geographies, adapt to new technologies, mentor others, and take end-to-end ownership.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with W&B alongside MLflow.
* Evidently AI or similar drift/monitoring platforms
* DVC or LakeFS for dataset versioning
* TorchServe / Triton / KServe (alternative serving paths)
* Exposure to large scale data or streaming platforms such as Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks in high volume processing contexts.

**Education Level**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  
At least 7 years

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.
  
  
**What The Team Owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

**Required**
Your skills and experience that will help you excel
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

Digital Health Solutions is a premier consulting company dedicated to providing comprehensive solutions to medical device companies. We specialize in helping our clients navigate the complexities of IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 compliance. Our team of skilled professionals is committed to delivering the highest level of service, ensuring that our clients' products are both safe and effective for their end users.

DHS employs a lean and efficient team wherein each capable member is involved in inter-disciplinary work, which develops their talent in business areas that go beyond technical know-how. You will work closely with hardware engineers, software developers, and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions. This role offers opportunities to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic environment.

**Position:**
Embedded Firmware Engineer.

**Required:**

· Minimum 2 years of Experience working with Embedded C/C++ based firmware development.

· Experience working with 8-bit / 32-bit microcontrollers such as STM, Microchip, nRF, etc.

· Proficient in working with peripheral buses and interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, PCI) and hardware peripherals, including ADCs, DACs, PWM controllers, GPIOs, and timers.

· Experience with both analog and digital sensors.

· Knowledge of Internet of Things (IoT) protocols and technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, GSM-GPRS, TCP-IP, MQTT, and LoRa.

· Strong understanding of embedded RTOS platforms such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, RTX, ThreadX, VxWorks, or similar.

· Ability to read and interpret schematics and component data sheets

· Capable of quickly learning and adapting to existing codebases and acquiring new technical skills.

· Highly motivated with demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

· Strong problem-solving skills to participate in troubleshooting of issues with different teams to drive towards root cause identification and resolution.

· Good team player with excellent communication skills, to be able to collaborate and work with cross functional teams.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment with a focus on technical excellence, responsiveness to meet timelines.

**Preferred:**

· Experience with Medical domain firmware development.

· Familiarity with unit testing and static analysis tools.

· Proficiency in scripting languages like Bash and Python for automation and embedded system tasks.

· Experience with debugging tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and other diagnostic equipment.

· Familiarity with using measuring and monitoring electronics test equipments like multimeter, digital oscilloscope, etc.

· Familiar with tools for managing project requirements, version control such as Git and WinMerge, for embedded systems.

· Experience with build systems like Makefile, CMake, or proprietary build environments for embedded platforms.

· Experience with embedded-specific IDEs and tools such as Keil uVision, VSCode, Eclipse.

**Responsibilities:**

· Design and develop embedded software and hardware solutions based on system requirements.

· Troubleshooting and debugging Embedded systems software & hardware issues.

· Conduct unit testing, code reviews, and validation of firmware to ensure quality and reliability.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software components.

· Document software development processes and maintain firmware for continuous improvement and scalability.

**Qualifications:**

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

title: .NET Developer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The .NET Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining reliable software solutions using modern Microsoft technologies. The role requires a strong hands-on developer with 2–5 years’ experience who can work confidently with modern .NET technologies including C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, RESTful services, and modern application development practices. The role also requires good SQL capability, preferably across SQL Server or Oracle, and practical exposure to modern UI frameworks such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. The developer will work closely with technical leads, business analysts, testers, architects, and delivery stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, well-tested, performant, and maintainable applications across enterprise platforms. Basic awareness of legacy .NET technologies is desirable to support existing applications and contribute to gradual modernisation where required.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Contribute to the delivery of modern, secure, scalable, and maintainable applications using C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, Entity Framework or similar ORM/data-access patterns, and relational databases.
* Apply sound engineering practices including clean coding, SOLID principles, unit testing, code reviews, source control discipline, and effective technical documentation.
* Support continuous improvement by adopting relevant tools, automation, cloud services, secure development practices, and AI-assisted engineering responsibly where appropriate.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Analyse business and technical requirements, clarify assumptions, and contribute to solution design with guidance from technical leads and architects.
* Design, build, enhance, and maintain application components across back-end services, APIs, database objects, integrations, and front-end features using React or similar modern UI frameworks where applicable.
* Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code using modern C#, ASP.NET Core, RESTful API patterns, asynchronous programming, LINQ, dependency injection, and SQL Server or Oracle.
* Develop and consume RESTful APIs, implement validation, authentication/authorisation checks, structured logging, exception handling, and robust error handling to support integration with internal and external systems.
* Work with SQL Server or Oracle to write and optimise queries, understand joins, indexes, stored procedures, execution behaviour, and troubleshoot performance or data-related issues.
* Contribute to UI development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including API integration, component-level changes, validation, and basic usability improvements.
* Prepare and maintain unit tests, support test automation where applicable, and work with testers to resolve defects through triage, root-cause analysis, and technical fixes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support maintenance and enhancement of existing legacy .NET applications where required, while contributing to gradual modernisation using current .NET, API, cloud, and UI development practices.
* Use Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, code review feedback, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes in line with team standards.

  
Collaboration & Team Contribution 
  

* Work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testers, architects, delivery managers, and support teams to deliver quality software outcomes.
* Communicate progress, risks, blockers, and technical considerations clearly and in a timely manner.
* Share knowledge with team members, contribute to documentation, and support a positive engineering culture focused on learning and continuous improvement.

  
Governance & Risk 
  

* Follow secure coding, data protection, accessibility, audit, and information security requirements relevant to enterprise financial technology applications.
* Support production stability by creating maintainable solutions, documenting changes, participating in defect analysis, and assisting with release and post-release support activities when required.

  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  

* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor of Engineering / MSc / BSc – IT / Computer Science / Any Graduate with relevant software development experience.
* 2–5 years of hands-on software development experience using modern C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful services, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of full SDLC, Agile delivery practices, requirements analysis, estimation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong SQL capability using SQL Server or Oracle, including writing complex queries, joins, stored procedures, indexes, performance-aware database access, query optimisation, and troubleshooting data-related issues.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating applications with internal or external systems.
* Strong understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code practices, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, security awareness, and performance considerations.
* Experience with unit testing, mocking frameworks, debugging, defect triage, and root-cause analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Git, pull requests, branching strategies, and collaborative code review practices.
* Working knowledge of Azure services, CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and cloud-based deployment practices is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot application issues across code, APIs, databases, logs, deployments, and environments, with a practical approach to root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.
* Expected to stay up to date with latest .NET ecosystem changes, Microsoft platform capabilities, secure development practices, and modern engineering tools including AI-assisted development where appropriate.
* Practical exposure to front-end development using React is preferred; experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, component-based UI development, API integration, and client-side validation will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of legacy .NET technologies such as .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms, WCF, or older enterprise application patterns will be an advantage, as some existing platforms may require maintenance, enhancement, troubleshooting, or gradual modernisation alongside modern .NET development.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, willingness to learn, adaptability to changing priorities, and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
  
  
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
  
  
**Summary Of Position**
Teladoc Health is seeking a
**Senior/Mid Software Engineer – Mirth / Healthcare Interoperability**
to join our engineering organization and build, enhance, and support healthcare integrations that enable the secure and reliable exchange of clinical and operational data.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on engineering role**
focused on Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. The engineer will design and implement complex integration workflows, troubleshoot production interfaces, collaborate with internal teams and external healthcare partners, and contribute to the evolution of our integration platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in
**Mirth Connect and HL7v2**
, combined with solid software engineering, integration, debugging, and production support skills. Experience with
**FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations, and healthcare interoperability standards**
is highly valued.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Healthcare Integration & Engineering**

* Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and maintain healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect.
* Develop complex integration workflows for HL7v2 message parsing, transformation, validation, routing, and delivery.
* Develop reusable and maintainable JavaScript-based transformations and business logic within Mirth Connect.
* Integrate healthcare systems using TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP, and other integration protocols.
* Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, healthcare organizations, and external vendors to design and implement interfaces.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of healthcare interoperability solutions and integration architecture.
* Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

**Production Support & Reliability**

* Monitor and support production healthcare interfaces and integration workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving message processing, transformation, routing, connectivity, certificates, and downstream systems.
* Troubleshoot network and protocol-level issues across MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Improve interface reliability through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and operational automation.
* Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production integrations.
* Ensure integration solutions meet appropriate security, reliability, and operational standards.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**

* Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors to deliver healthcare integration solutions.
* Communicate technical designs, issues, risks, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in technical design and architecture reviews.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews and promote standards for secure, scalable, and maintainable integration development.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, mapping documents, design documents, and operational runbooks.
* Mentor engineers and serve as a technical resource for Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across the integration platform.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering and/or healthcare integration experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Mirth Connect integrations.
* Strong, practical knowledge of HL7v2, including message structure, segments, fields, components, repetitions, acknowledgments, and common message types.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Mirth Connect channels, including connectors, filters, transformers, and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity, message delivery, transformation, routing, and downstream system issues in production environments.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript for Mirth transformations and integration logic.
* Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores/truststores, and secure endpoint configuration.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with FHIR, including FHIR resources, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience with EHR/EMR integrations and healthcare information exchange.
* Experience with CCDA/C-CDA.
* Familiarity with XDS.b and XCA.
* Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards and architectures.
* Experience developing or integrating with REST APIs and web services.
* Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Experience with other healthcare interface engines such as Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Mirth Connect Certified Developer (MCCD) certification.
* Participation in Mirth Connect, healthcare interoperability, or open-source technical communities.

title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Send is part of Duck Creek Technologies, the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry.
  
  
Founded in 2017, Send was created with a clear ambition: to transform commercial insurance underwriting by combining deep industry expertise with modern technology. Today, Send’s award-winning underwriting workbench helps commercial insurers improve the way underwriting teams access information, make decisions, collaborate, and manage complex risks.
  
  
Following Send’s acquisition by Duck Creek Technologies, we are bringing together Send’s specialist commercial underwriting capabilities with Duck Creek’s scale, expertise, and modern SaaS platform. Together, we have an exciting opportunity to deliver even greater value to insurers and help shape the future of commercial insurance technology.
  
  
As part of Duck Creek Technologies, the Send team benefits from the scale, investment, expertise, and global reach of a market-leading insurance technology organization while continuing to build on the specialist underwriting expertise and entrepreneurial culture that have driven Send’s success.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
As our Senior Software Engineer in our Delivery and Support team, you will keep Send’s underwriting platform running well for our customers. You’ll predominantly own application and production support for live customer environments, working closely with the customer implementation projects at the point of handoff. This role sits alongside our core product engineering team rather than within it. You’ll work closely with Delivery, Product, Engineering and customer stakeholders to resolve issues quickly, configure and extend the platform for each customer’s needs, and feed what you learn back into the product. It suits a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving real problems that directly affect customers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide application and production support for live customer environments. You’ll investigate, diagnose and resolve incidents, defects and performance issues across global our customer base.
* Own issues from first report to resolution, including root-cause analysis, fixes, clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders, and steps to stop them happening again.
* Sometimes get involved with the delivery of customer implementation projects by configuring, integrating and extending the platform to meet customer requirements.
* Work with Delivery, Product and core Engineering to turn customer requirements into maintainable solutions and pass recurring issues and product gaps back to the product team.
* Build quality into delivery through unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and maintaining reliable and performant services.
* Improve our engineering and delivery capabilities through CI/CD and deployment automation, while contributing to architectural decisions that enhance the platform’s scalability and performance.

**What You Bring**

* At least 5 years of professional Java engineering experience, with strong experience developing backend web applications.
* Proficiency with Spring Boot, REST APIs, JPA, and Hibernate, together with experience working with relational databases such as MySQL.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and software engineering best practices, including unit and integration testing and maintaining high code quality.
* A proactive, pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
* Experience with AWS, Apache Camel, Docker, Kubernetes, or other relevant cloud and DevOps technologies is beneficial.
* Experience in the insurance industry or working with insurance-related software is beneficial.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Join a specialist team solving some of the most important challenges in commercial insurance underwriting.
* Contribute to an award-winning underwriting technology platform while being part of Duck Creek Technologies, one of the leading technology providers in the global P&C insurance industry.
* Benefit from the scale, investment, expertise, and global reach of Duck Creek while continuing to work within the specialist and entrepreneurial environment that has driven Send’s success.

**Additional Information**
Location: Mumbai or Bengaluru, India - Hybrid
  
  
Work Authorization: This position does not sponsor employment-based visas.
  
  
**Location & Ways Of Working**
Send, a Duck Creek Company, operates within Duck Creek’s flexible-first working model, giving employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work while creating intentional opportunities for meaningful in-person collaboration.
  
  
This role is aligned to Mumbai or Bengaluru, India, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to one of those locations. You will partner with your leader to participate in in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, customer engagement, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As Duck Creek’s Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Send, a Duck Creek Company, is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves.
  
  
**Our Values Guide Us**
We Prioritize Respect. We Listen. We Care. We Add Value. We Lead.
  
  
**Learn More**
**Duck Creek Technologies**
https://www.duckcreek.com/
  
  
**Life At Duck Creek**
https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
**Benefits & Rewards**
https://www.duckcreek.com/wellbeing-and-rewards/
  
  
**AI Statement**
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
**Privacy Notice**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with its Privacy Notice and applicable data protection laws.
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept, nor will we pay a fee for, any hires resulting from unsolicited headhunter or agency resumes.

title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.
  
  
**Job Title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer (C/C++ & Driver Development)
  
  
Location | Remote
  
  
Time Zone | US Time Zones (EST–PST)**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Security Developer with strong C, C++, and Windows driver development skills to help build an AI-focused endpoint protection platform. This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role. Your first focus will be building a Windows service that collects system, network, and process data to detect and respond to threats. The ideal candidate knows Windows internals well and enjoys building fast, reliable security software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Windows endpoint services, including kernel-mode and user-mode modules

* Collaborate with the team on threat research strategies and translate them into detection logic using endpoint telemetry
* Perform advanced debugging and troubleshooting across kernel and user mode using WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Ensure compliance with Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, Secure Boot, and kernel security restrictions
* Optimize agent performance to minimize system impact while maintaining visibility and protection
* Participate in threat modeling, secure coding reviews, and internal security assessments

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience working on Windows endpoint security products such as AV, EDR, DLP, firewall, or intrusion prevention (non-negotiable)
* Deep expertise in C, C++, and Windows driver development
* Strong understanding of Windows OS fundamentals and internals
* Experience with kernel-mode communication mechanisms (IOCTL, ALPC, shared memory)
* Proficiency with WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Knowledge of Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Understanding of Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, and Secure Boot
* Experience with threat modeling and secure coding practices
* Strong written and spoken English with a clear, professional communication style
* Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with cross-platform endpoint security (macOS/Linux)
* Experience building telemetry or behavioral analytics pipelines for threat detection
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven security products or monitoring AI agent activity

**Tools & Technology**

* C and C++
* Windows Driver Frameworks (WDM, KMDF, UMDF)
* Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* WinDbg and Sysinternals tools
* Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

**Please NOTE**
It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps—the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.
  
  
We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:
**About The Role**
What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Mumbai to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
  
  
You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
* Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
* Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
* Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't
* Design challenging coding prompts and edge-case scenarios to stress-test AI capabilities
* Compare and rank multiple AI-generated solutions based on engineering quality
* Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

* Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles

* Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach

* Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision

**Nice to Have**

* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
